divergences.summary: Rename trims outer whitespace and writes nothing when the trimmed name is unchanged; the pinned Actual's handler writes every submitted value. Cause: BudgetDatabase+AccountLifecycleWrites.swift:66 (trim) and :72 (no change).
divergences.reason: User decision 2026-10-11: trimming and skipping an unchanged rename are harmless and intended.

divergences.summary: Finishing reconciliation with a nonzero difference throws balanceChanged, where the pinned Actual records no error and locks zero transactions (nonzeroDifferenceLocks 0). Cause: BudgetDatabase+Reconciliation.swift:221-222 guards on canLockTransactions and throws. Expected output: reconciliation-contract.json, case finish.
divergences.reason: User decision 2026-10-11: telling the user the balance changed under them is safer than finishing silently.

divergences.summary: A balance adjustment whose rule clears notes still records the default note 'Reconciliation balance adjustment', where the pinned Actual leaves notes null. Cause: BudgetDatabase+Reconciliation.swift:140-142 restores the default note when the draft and preview notes are both nil or empty.
divergences.reason: User decision 2026-10-11: the adjustment always carries its default note, even over a rule that clears notes.

divergences.summary: A balance adjustment whose rule deletes it writes no tombstone, where the pinned Actual's expected output records one deleted row. Cause: BudgetDatabase+Reconciliation.swift:130-135 returns committed false when the rule preview deletes the transaction. The delete rule is authored by the replay adapter (ReconciliationOracleReplaySupport.swift), so the expected deletion is a scripted outcome; see the README.
divergences.reason: User decision 2026-10-11: writing nothing is cleaner than a create plus tombstone; the end state is identical and adjustment rows carry no imported ID, so nothing dedupes against them.

divergences.summary: Unlocking a child of a reconciled split writes reconciled = false to the parent and both children, where the pinned Actual's real unlock sends nothing: the grouped query returns the family, but makeChild copies the parent's reconciled value, so the update carries no change and all three rows stay reconciled (readback.after). Cause: BudgetDatabase+Reconciliation.swift:290-306 unlocks every reconciled row of the family. unlock-split-parent, unlock-split-member-unreconciled-parent and unlock-simple-row match the oracle.
divergences.reason: User decision 2026-10-11: unlocking any part of a split unlocks the family; Actual's child unlock is a no-op because makeChild copies the parent's reconciled.

divergences.summary: A category with a null stored goal_def but a #template or #goal directive in its note gets no budget at apply; the pinned Actual regenerates goal_def from the note first, so the same case budgets it. Cause: BudgetDatabase+TemplateCategoryReads.swift:29-39 reads only stored goal_def and nothing regenerates it from the note at apply (called from BudgetDatabase+TemplatePreview.swift:354). The Swift replay that seeds the oracle's definition (replaysTemplateEngineWithStoredDefinitions) matches the oracle in every one of these cases, so the apply engine agrees once the definition exists. BudgetDatabase+TemplateNoteSync.swift:9 says Actualist applies CRDT-synced goal_def directly, so this may be a deliberate difference; the product decides. Up-to-date cases in this set produce zero messages, as the oracle does.
divergences.reason: User decision 2026-10-11: Actual is deprecating note-based templates, so Actualist does not support them; only stored template definitions apply.

divergences.summary: A stored template definition that no longer matches its category note makes the whole apply refuse, with no budget written in any category. The pinned Actual clears the stale definition and applies the other categories (tapply-named-stale-note-goal-def: Synthetic Rent's definition is cleared, Synthetic Groceries is budgeted 30000). Cause: the stale-note guard in BudgetDatabase+TemplatePreview.swift:378-392 throws unsupportedTemplate before any write, with the comparison from staleNoteManagedTemplateCategories (BudgetDatabase+TemplateNoteSync.swift:37). BudgetDatabase+TemplateNoteSync.swift:9-30 describes the guard as the safety half of Actual's preprocessing, so the refusal may be deliberate; the product decides. Once the refusal is removed, Synthetic Groceries also needs the OP-24 behavior.
divergences.reason: User decision 2026-10-11: refusing Apply Templates when a stored definition no longer matches its note is intended; the user resolves the mismatch first.

divergences.summary: A move or cover writes no 'Reassigned … from … on …' month note, where the pinned Actual writes one. Only the note's presence is compared; its date text comes from the fixture's fake clock and is not compared. Cause: no Reassigned writer exists in Actualist/. The move seam is BudgetDatabase+BudgetWrites.swift:210-240 and the cover commands OverspentCoverSelectionWorkflow.swift:58-84.
divergences.reason: User decision 2026-10-11: Actualist does not add automatic 'Reassigned' month notes on moves or covers.

divergences.summary: Skipping the next date of a one-time schedule is refused with an unsupported-capability error, where the pinned Actual accepts the skip and leaves the schedule unchanged. The stored result is the same. Cause: canSkip requires a recurrence (ScheduleRuleProjection.swift:105) and prepareScheduleSkip throws at BudgetDatabase+ScheduleWrites.swift:310-312.
divergences.reason: User decision 2026-10-11: Actualist hides Skip Next Date for one-time schedules, so the refusal is unreachable from the UI and the saved data is identical; Actual's menu offers a skip that does nothing.

divergences.summary: A schedule created on a day gets its first next date from that day, where the pinned Actual searches from the day before in a time zone behind UTC (a daily-every-3-days schedule from 2026-10-01 created on 2026-10-11 in America/New_York starts on 2026-10-10 in Actual and 2026-10-13 in Actualist). Cause: Actual's createSchedule calls getNextDate with the default start new Date(currentDay()), which parses the day as UTC midnight; Actualist's ScheduleRuleMutation.initialNextDate (ScheduleRuleMutation.swift:172) starts at the given day. Not the cause of OP-13.
divergences.reason: User decision 2026-10-11: keep the local creation day. Actual's UTC parse of the creation day looks like an upstream bug that can start a new schedule a day early west of UTC; both apps read the stored next date afterwards.

divergences.summary: Creating a schedule on a closed account is refused ("Choose an available, open account for this schedule."), where the pinned Actual's createSchedule accepts any account in the rule. Actual's own editor does not offer closed accounts, so this is an API-level difference. Cause: validateScheduleAccount rejects a closed or deleted account (BudgetDatabase+ScheduleWrites.swift:412-420).
divergences.reason: User decision 2026-10-11: keep refusing closed accounts at create. Neither app's editor offers a closed account, and advancement of an existing schedule on a closed account already matches Actual.

divergences.summary: A matched row in an off-budget account never takes the category a rule or download supplies, where the pinned Actual writes it (it strips categories only on inserts). Cause: mergedCategoryID returns the row's own category for off-budget accounts (BankSyncReconciler.swift:370-383). Deliberate: reference/mistakes.md 2026-09-16 'Bank Sync must not categorize off-budget accounts'.
divergences.reason: User decision 2026-10-11: off-budget accounts carry no categories, so a matched off-budget row keeps none (2026-09-16 guard).

divergences.summary: The first-sync Starting Balance amount is the current balance minus the planned inserts, where the pinned Actual subtracts every raw downloaded transaction, including ones a rule changes and, with import-pending off, pending ones that are skipped. Cause: BankSyncReconciliation.openingBalance subtracts the inserts only (BankSyncReconciler.swift:480-489). Deliberate: reference/mistakes.md 2026-09-06 'Bank Sync forgets deleted bank IDs and balances before reconciliation' (derive opening balance from planned inserts).
divergences.reason: User decision 2026-10-11: the Starting Balance plus the rows actually imported equals the bank balance; Actual also subtracts rows a rule drops or pending rows it skips.

divergences.summary: The Starting Balance row is dated at the earliest downloaded day, where the pinned Actual uses the date of the last transaction in the download, which differs when the download is listed oldest first or its last row is skipped. Cause: earliestDayID is candidateDayIDs.min() (LocalFirstActualStore+BankSyncPlanning.swift:390).
divergences.reason: User decision 2026-10-11: date the Starting Balance on the earliest downloaded day, independent of the bank's row order and of skipped rows.

divergences.summary: With reimport-deleted off, a download whose provider ID belongs to a deleted row is skipped and the deleted row is left alone, where the pinned Actual matches the deleted row and rewrites its payee and imported payee (it stays deleted). Cause: BankSyncReconciliation.plan returns skippedDeleted for suppressed IDs (BankSyncReconciler.swift:197-204) fed by bankSyncSuppressedFinancialIDs (LocalFirstActualStore+ImportReconcile.swift:50-58). Deliberate: reference/mistakes.md 2026-09-06 (deleted IDs are used only for exact dedupe, never for updates).
divergences.reason: User decision 2026-10-11: leave deleted rows untouched; with reimport-deleted off, both apps ignore the download and the visible result is identical.

divergences.summary: When a split parent is matched by ID, its children are excluded from fuzzy matching for the whole batch, so a later download with a child's amount is inserted as a new row; the pinned Actual v26.10.0 lets it match the child. Cause: exactMatchedParentIDs and isReserved (BankSyncReconciler.swift:199, :218-221), a port of loot-core 24deae7 (comment at BankSyncReconciler.swift:158-161) that postdates the pin.
divergences.reason: User decision 2026-10-11: keep the port of upstream 24deae7 (reserve children of an ID-matched split parent), which landed after v26.10.0. Recheck at the next oracle pin, where it should match.

divergences.summary: A provider payee name with leading or trailing spaces creates a trimmed payee, where the pinned Actual creates the payee with the spaces (the imported payee is trimmed in both). Cause: payee creation trims the name (BudgetDatabase+TransactionCreation.swift:29-35) and prepareDownload trims the mapped name (LocalFirstActualStore+BankSyncPlanning.swift:320-321).
divergences.reason: User decision 2026-10-11: create payees with trimmed names.

divergences.summary: When several stored rows are equally distant from a download and equally eligible, Actualist matches the row stored first, where the pinned Actual matches another of them (its candidate order comes from an unordered query and a comparator that returns -1 for equal distances), so a different row is updated. Cause: fuzzyDataset sorts by distance then stored order (BankSyncReconciler.swift:323).
divergences.reason: User decision 2026-10-11: keep the deterministic tie-break (first stored row); Actual's choice comes from an unordered query.

divergences.summary: When two live rows in one account carry the same provider ID, a download with that ID updates a different one of them: the pinned Actual takes the first row its query returns, Actualist takes the first row in stored order. Cause: idMatch is existing.first (BankSyncReconciler.swift:193-196).
divergences.reason: User decision 2026-10-11: keep the deterministic choice (first stored row) when provider IDs repeat; Actual's choice comes from an unordered query.

divergences.summary: Duplicating a split whose children do not add up to the parent is refused, where the pinned Actual clones the parent with its split error and the child. Cause: TransactionDuplicatePlanner.swift:290-324 throws malformedSplit for a family that fails the split invariants; BudgetDatabase+TransactionDuplicate.swift reports it as 'cannot be duplicated'.
divergences.reason: User decision 2026-10-11 (ratified contract): a malformed split is never duplicated (admission, D2 split error); Actual clones it.

divergences.summary: Merging a selected split child is refused (selectedChild; two children of one family overlap), where the pinned Actual keeps or drops the child alone and tombstones the other row. Cause: TransactionMergePlanner.swift:34 and :270.
divergences.reason: User decision 2026-10-11 (ratified contract): all selected-child shapes are blocked in a manual merge (admission, C5: the oracle established no compatible family-root interpretation).

divergences.summary: Merging a split with no children, or a family whose children do not add up (split error), is refused, where the pinned Actual merges them. Cause: BudgetDatabase+TransactionBatchSnapshots.swift:53 (no live entries) and TransactionMergePlanner.swift:289 (splitHasError).
divergences.reason: User decision 2026-10-11 (ratified contract): zero-child, error and malformed split sources are blocked (admission, C5).

divergences.summary: Merging a transfer whose peer is missing, or a pair that does not link back, is refused, where the pinned Actual merges them (and for a missing peer tombstones the row). Cause: BudgetDatabase+TransactionBatchSnapshots.swift:79-88 marks the graph invalid.
divergences.reason: User decision 2026-10-11 (ratified contract): missing or nonreciprocal transfers are blocked; Actualist never creates a skeletal peer or repairs a backlink (admission, C5).

divergences.summary: Keeping a split parent and dropping a simple row is refused, where the pinned Actual merges them and gives the parent the simple row's payee and category. Cause: TransactionMergePlanner.swift:441 blocks a retained split parent that would gain a category or payee.
divergences.reason: User decision 2026-10-11 (ratified contract): the observed invalid after-graph where a retained split parent gains a category or payee from a simple row is blocked (admission, C5).

divergences.summary: A merge that is refused leaves every row untouched, where the pinned Actual's handler has already written four transferred_id = null messages (all four rows of both pairs) before it refuses. Both refuse. Cause: BudgetDatabase+TransactionMerge.swift plans and validates the whole graph before the single atomic commit.
divergences.reason: User decision 2026-10-11 (ratified contract): the merge commits the full graph atomically and never emits pre-validation messages (admission, C5).

divergences.summary: Undo of a merge is blocked after a later edit to a merged row (the note changed), where the pinned Actual's in-memory undo applies it and overwrites the edit. Cause: BudgetDatabase+ActionLog.swift:525-533 compares every live row with the recorded after-state and returns transactionCommandChanged.
divergences.reason: User decision 2026-10-11 (ratified contract): one full-graph, conflict-safe Undo is mandatory; every live row must match the recorded after-state or Undo blocks before writing (admission, C5).

divergences.summary: Free-text search is flat across split children: searching text that only a child's note contains returns just that child, with no parent and no sibling context, where the pinned Actual's grouped account query returns the parent family with the parent and sibling as unmatched context (rootIDs [parent], 3 displayed, 2 context). The individually matching ids agree. Cause: fetchTransactionQueryPage routes any text query to flatTransactionQuerySelection (BudgetDatabase+TransactionQuery.swift:122-131). The grouped read fetchTransactionPage(matching:splits:.grouped) does return the family (split-mode case child-note-search matches).
divergences.reason: User decision 2026-10-11 (ratified contract, Q3): free-text search is flat across split children in Actualist; Actual groups the match to the parent.

divergences.summary: A deleted parent hides its orphan child in the all-rows read, and so does a child whose parent row is missing: Actualist returns [simple], where the pinned Actual's splits: all returns [simple, orphan, missing-parent-child] (Actual applies its alive filter only to inline and none; inline, none, grouped and the account balance agree). Cause: liveEffectivePredicate always includes alivePredicate (BudgetDatabase+TransactionSplitQuery.swift:80-93) and fetchTransactionPage seeds it for every mode (BudgetDatabase+TransactionReads.swift:127). TransactionSplitQueryTests.deadParentExcludesOrphanFromLiveReadsAndBalances hard-codes the Actualist value.
divergences.reason: User decision 2026-10-11: keep orphaned split children (deleted or missing parent) hidden in every read, including the all-rows read used by feed search. They are damaged data; Actual's own fix is Repair transactions in the web app, which deletes them, and those deletions sync.

divergences.summary: On every create path Actualist writes structural default cells that Actual leaves to column defaults: transactions.tombstone = 0, isParent = 0 and parent_id = null on a simple row (BudgetDatabase+TransactionCreation.swift:198-221), plus isChild = 0 and error = null on each transfer leg (transactionRowMessages, :350-370), and payees.tombstone = 0 on a newly created payee (:55-64). The pinned Actual's insert (db.insertTransaction / payee-create) sends only the cells it sets. Row state is the same once applied; the message stream is not.

Actualist writes explicit null cells for unset optional values where Actual writes nothing: notes = null and category = null on a simple row (BudgetDatabase+TransactionCreation.swift:150-186) and notes and category = null on each transfer leg and description = null on a payee-less import row (transactionRowMessages, :332-338). Actual's batch update and import omit absent fields. Row state is the same once applied.

Actualist writes no sort_order on a manual create, on either transfer leg, or on the Starting Balance row; the pinned Actual writes sort_order on every new row (the clock in ms). Cause: TransactionDraft.sortOrder is nil on the manual and transfer paths (LocalFirstActualStore+TransactionMutations.swift:96-110, BudgetDatabase+TransactionCreation.swift:448,466), and makeBankSyncOpeningBalanceMessages takes a sortOrder it never uses (BudgetDatabase+BankSync.swift:691-720). The replay compares presence only. Import inserts do write sort_order and match.

Actualist never writes reconciled = 0 when it creates a transaction (manual, transfer, import or starting balance); the pinned Actual writes it on every new row. Cause: BudgetDatabase+TransactionCreation.swift:272 writes reconciled only for a scheduled post, and transactionRowMessages writes it only when a caller passes a value (:343-345).

A manual create with no payee is refused, where the pinned Actual writes the transaction with no payee (description unset). Cause: resolveOrCreatePayeeMessages throws 'missing payee name' for an empty name (BudgetDatabase+TransactionCreation.swift:29-31), and the store throws 'missing payee' when no payee resolves (LocalFirstActualStore+TransactionMutations.swift:105).

The Starting Balance row takes the first live income category by sort order (so 'Income' in a default budget), where the pinned Actual takes the income category named 'Starting Balances' and falls back to the first income category only when that name is missing. Cause: bankSyncIncomeCategoryID (BudgetDatabase+BankSync.swift:416-430) has no name lookup. Off-budget Starting Balance rows carry no category in both.

Category on a transfer create differs from Actual in two shapes. Off-budget to on-budget: Actualist puts the chosen category on the paired on-budget leg, where Actual's batch update clears the category of the off-budget source leg and leaves the on-budget leg uncategorized (transferCategories, BudgetDatabase+TransactionCreation.swift:556-575). On-budget to on-budget with a category supplied: Actual writes the category then clears it with a null write; Actualist never writes the category, so the final row state matches but the intermediate cell does not.
